title: Mail Memories – A desktop app to rescue photos from Gmail
claim: Show HN: Mail Memories – A desktop app to rescue photos from Gmail
why_good: Many users struggle to manage and retrieve photos buried in their email, presenting a clear pain point for a dedicated solution.
value: Consumers could pay for a subscription service that offers enhanced features like cloud storage integration and advanced search capabilities.
risk: The app may face challenges if Google decides to integrate similar functionalities directly into Gmail.
